title: Father and Baby Marcelle, B&W Snapshot, 1967
description: A heartwarming black and white family snapshot taken in April 1967, depicting a father leaning down outdoors to interact with his 11-month-old daughter, Marcelle. The father wears a plaid flannel shirt, while Marcelle reaches out toward him near a garden bench holding a paint bucket and terracotta pots. The margin includes a photo processing stamp reading 'APR 67', capturing a sweet moment of suburban domestic life in 1960s America.
